sentences.en: He lost his credibility because he betrayed a friend.
sentences.zh: 由于背叛了朋友，他失去了信誉。

sentences.en: For running for a fifth mandate, Bouteflika damaged his own credibility.
sentences.zh: 为了竞选第五个任期，布特弗利卡损害了自己的信誉。

sentences.en: The government has lost credibility with the public.
sentences.zh: 政府已经失去了公众的信任。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：cred（相信）+ibility（可…性）→可信性，可靠性
